blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The body was established as a Statutory Tribunal under the Act of 2010.
It is headquartered in New Delhi.
Appeals against its decisions are made directly to the Supreme Court.
Cases brought before it must be resolved within a 6-month limit.
Core operational principles include Polluter Pays, Precautionary, and Sustainable Development.
